name: B10-0174/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Democracy and human rights in Thailand, notably the lese-majesty law and the deportation of Uyghur refugees
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on democracy and human rights in Thailand, notably the lese-majesty law and the deportation of Uyghur refugees
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking for action. It asks Thailand to stop using its strict lese-majesty law, which punishes insults to the monarchy, to silence critics, and to release people held under it. It also condemns Thailand for sending 40 Uyghur refugees back to China, where they could be tortured, and asks Thailand to stop all such deportations and protect asylum seekers.

- Thailand is asked to repeal its lese-majesty law and free people held under it.
- Thailand is condemned for deporting 40 Uyghurs to China; it should stop all deportations.
- China is asked to let observers see the returned Uyghurs and release them.
